about: The commands, shortcuts and settings of the VS Code extension (its package.json).

rows.title: VS Code: the commands of the Nuclear extension and their shortcuts
rows.summary: The 87 commands the Nuclear extension adds to VS Code, each with its keyboard shortcut: the workspace, run and debug, devices, HTTP Connections, the Builder, Nuclear Atlas and the settings.
body: - %command.nuclear.workspace.tool% — `ctrl+alt+h (arg http-connections), ctrl+alt+p (arg builder), ctrl+alt+d (arg designer), ctrl+alt+m (arg docs), ctrl+alt+a (arg atlas), ctrl+alt+s (arg settings), ctrl+alt+e (arg teams), ctrl+alt+k (arg reports), ctrl+alt+f (arg monitor), ctrl+alt+y (arg environments), ctrl+alt+v (arg devices)` (`nuclear.workspace.tool`)

- %command.nuclear.workspace.project% — `ctrl+1 (arg 1), ctrl+2 (arg 2), ctrl+3 (arg 3), ctrl+4 (arg 4), ctrl+5 (arg 5), ctrl+6 (arg 6), ctrl+7 (arg 7), ctrl+8 (arg 8), ctrl+9 (arg 9)` (`nuclear.workspace.project`)

commands.title: %command.nuclear.workspace.tool%
commands.keys: ctrl+alt+h (arg http-connections), ctrl+alt+p (arg builder), ctrl+alt+d (arg designer), ctrl+alt+m (arg docs), ctrl+alt+a (arg atlas), ctrl+alt+s (arg settings), ctrl+alt+e (arg teams), ctrl+alt+k (arg reports), ctrl+alt+f (arg monitor), ctrl+alt+y (arg environments), ctrl+alt+v (arg devices)

commands.title: %command.nuclear.workspace.project%
commands.keys: ctrl+1 (arg 1), ctrl+2 (arg 2), ctrl+3 (arg 3), ctrl+4 (arg 4), ctrl+5 (arg 5), ctrl+6 (arg 6), ctrl+7 (arg 7), ctrl+8 (arg 8), ctrl+9 (arg 9)
